## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：只改内部测试清单里七条记录页测试项的文字，产品本身不变。
- 记录页去掉右侧摘要栏、主从子表改为默认作页签之后，这七条仍按旧布局写，照着跑会把正常的产品判成失败；属于记录页重做专题。
- 出错只会让测试员照错误的步骤操作、得出错误结论，不影响任何用户，改回文字即可撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

Seven platform-checklist items still described the record page's right summary rail (retired by the ruling on the layout card, comment 7064066204: fields pinned in the left column when 320 + 400 fit; landed in `48c732c4`), its 最近动态 card, the first tab's old name 概览, or the e2e spec under its old name. One of them also asserted the master_detail rule `f3c9d426f` replaced. Each is rewritten in place, with `revision` bumped and a `history` row (README "Lifecycle — Change"); none is retired, because every subject is still live.

| Item | Rev | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `records-forms.crud-roundtrip` | 21 → 22 | steps[5], acceptance[4].verify: stream from the Activity tab or `?related=timeline`; first tab 详情; the account page never pins (its 'primary' body tables) |
| `records-forms.related-list-server-pagination` | 14 → 15 | steps[0–2,5,7], acceptance[2,5].verify: no 其他相关 cards; Contacts read as its tab; today's `relatedList` describe quoted |
| `records-forms.record-edit-undo` | 8 → 9 | steps[2]: stream from the Activity tab; a wide full page pins the details with no 详情 tab |
| `records-forms.field-history-tracking` | 14 → 15 | steps[3], acceptance[2].verify: the audit read at open rests on `historyConsumerOnScreen`, not the retired card; the drawer half, which named the rail, is dropped |
| `records-forms.master-detail-body-tables` | 1 → 2 | rewritten to the tab-by-default rule: fixture `showcase_expense_report` (group `lines` places `showcase_expense_line`); the table sits at the group's position, keeps its tab, the page never pins; Tasks on a project stays as the tab-only contrast in the drawer |
| `records-forms.related-tab-arrangement` | 1 → 2 | 概览 → 详情 throughout; e2e spec renamed `record-tabs-rail-35595.spec.ts` → `record-tabs-35595.spec.ts`; Northwind never pins |
| `attachments-storage.download-authz-both-sides` | 12 → 13 | steps[6]: the panel is the face of the 附件 tab, beside the pinned details or on the one-column row |

Sources for every rewritten assertion (all at base `28ba01fe`):

- Pinning: `recordPagePinsDetails` and `RECORD_PAGE_PIN_MIN_WIDTH` (320 + 24 + 400) in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/recordPageColumns.ts`; pinned by `RecordPageColumns.test.tsx` ("pins: details left at 400 px…", "a page whose field groups place a related table among the fields does not pin", "a drawer or pane (no `fullPage`) never pins").
- Tab row and markers: `RecordPageColumns.tsx` (`data-record-page-pinned`, `data-record-columns-shown`, tabs without 详情 when pinned, the implied first tab), `RecordTabRow.tsx` (`data-record-tab`); 详情 is `detail.recordTabOverview` in every locale.
- Audit read at open: `RecordDetailView.tsx` `historyConsumerOnScreen`; pinned by `RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010.test.tsx` ("a trackHistory record reads the audit log at open…").
- Tab by default / group placement / keeps its tab / declared `relatedLists` drops it: `deriveRelatedLists.ts` (`keepsTab`), `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts#bodyTablePlacement`; pinned by `buildDefaultPageSchema.bodyTables-27055.test.ts`, `deriveRelatedLists.test.ts`, `deriveRelatedLists.relatedListsOrder-27069.test.ts`, `RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx` (the five relation-type cells).
- Fixture: `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/expense-report.object.ts` (`fieldGroups` report / lines / totals) and the seed's EXP-2001 lines. `showcase_invoice` was not used: its default record page is the authored `kind: 'full'` invoice document, drawn as written on the desktop full page.
- Attachments tab: `RecordPageColumns.tsx` (`RECORD_TAB_ATTACHMENTS`), drawn by `record-attachments-renderer.tsx` as `RecordAttachmentsPanel`.

This also covers released card #35846 (the master-detail item now asserts the merged rule). Text only: no code, no `skills/**` (PR #36222 did that).

## Acceptance notes

- Overlap (resolved 2026-11-22): PR #36273 merged first (`d953558b9`). This branch merged `origin/main` at `1cd47628e` as merge commit `28973d379`, with no rebase. In `related-list-server-pagination` steps[1], the quote is now main's `relatedList` describe word for word, re-read at `1cd47628e`, and the item stays at one revision bump on top of main (14 → 15). After the merge, overlap-check is clean. Rework report: card comment 7075633975.
- `skip-changeset`: `docs/qa/**` sits in the private root package and in no package's `files[]`, so nothing publishes.
- Not filed (polish/naming): several test titles still say 「概览」 for the tab that now reads 详情; the docblocks of `RECORD_PAGE_WIDE_MIN_WIDTH` / `RECORD_PAGE_TWO_COLUMN_MIN_WIDTH` and the tier comment in `RecordDetailView.tsx` still describe a right column.
- Revision 1 of `master-detail-body-tables` opened `showcase_project`'s full page, whose default record page is an authored `kind: 'full'` page; the rewrite reads Tasks in the drawer, which draws the standard page.
- Not measured: whether Northwind's tab row holds three side lists today (`related-tab-arrangement` fixture); the example list now names only what the showcase declares.

## Verification

Read first: `records-forms.json` item `master-detail-body-tables` (the full rewrite), then `related-list-server-pagination` steps[1], then `attachments-storage.json` `download-authz-both-sides` steps[6].

Two-minute check: `pnpm check:platform-checklist` prints `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 436 items`.
